gift_card_ledger_sign.name: gift_card_ledger_sign
gift_card_ledger_sign.value: ("gift_card_ledger"."kind"::text IN ('issue', 'reverse') AND "gift_card_ledger"."amount_cents" > 0) OR ("gift_card_ledger"."kind"::text IN ('redeem', 'void') AND "gift_card_ledger"."amount_cents" < 0) OR "gift_card_ledger"."kind"::text = 'adjust'

menus_dates_ordered.name: menus_dates_ordered
menus_dates_ordered.value: "menus"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "menus"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "menus"."starts_on" <= "menus"."ends_on"
